Authentic Italian Hidden Gem
Aug 2026 • Couples
I stayed in Da Nang for two weeks, and this was one of the few restaurants I kept coming back to. I returned every two or three days, and what impressed me was that the menu was constantly changing, so there was always something new to try.

I've always been a big fan of Italian food, but there is something quite special about this restaurant. The owner must come from a seaside hometown, because the seafood pastas are exceptionally well done. The fish and seafood are treated with simplicity and care, allowing the ingredients to really shine rather than being overwhelmed by heavy sauces.

The staff also know the menu very well and are genuinely good at recommending dishes based on what you like, which made each visit even more enjoyable.

And definitely save room for dessert , they are wonderful.

A place I was genuinely happy to return to again and again during my stay in Da Nang.

This Italian is quite hidden in a little street, but the food was really surprised all of us, we ordered 2 main courses and 1 pasta to share, all of them taste amazing, and we ordered 1 more main course as we wanted to try out more dishes, all of them are really tasty, we all cannot believe we could taste an international five star hotel standard food in this little hidden restaurant!
